messages:
alexa: Heads up 10:00 PT 1: We need final rules for SI handoffs tied to the marketplace launch. Quick sync?
sam-k: Yep. Topline: decide auto-claim thresholds, claim TTL, and special handling for HW partners and on-prem requests.
diego: Proposal incoming: (a) ARR >= 75k or P0 product -> route to SI-intake; (b) marketplace leads with partner_flag=true -> tag SI_AUTO; (c) claim TTL 48h for AE, then requeue.
li-zhang: Concern: 48h might be short for EMEA/APAC timezones. Suggest TTL: 72h global but SLA for triage ack = 6 business hours in origin timezone.
alexa: Good point. Also need to capture listing metadata in CRM: partner_origin, hw_accelerator=true, marketplace_listing_id. That will let us filter reports.
sam-k: Implementation note: intake lambda will expose partner_origin & hw_accelerator in webhook. Pseudocode: if (lead.meta.hw_accelerator || lead.ARR >= 75000) routeTo('si-intake') else routeTo('sdr').
diego: Add escalation field: "si_escalation_level" with values none/ops/partnerships/legal. Useful for automation.
ops-bot: New marketplace: summit-hw-2026 (partner_id:summit). Payload: {listing_id: 999, partner_id: summit, hw_accelerator: true, contact: lead@acme.com}
li-zhang: ops-bot posts should create SI triage ticket when hw_accelerator=true. Ticket fields: account, contact, ARR_est, listing_id, partner_id, region.
alexa: For joint announcements and demos: require (1) joint messaging doc in drive, (2) marketing checklist sign-off, (3) security sign-off for private deployments. We'll add checkboxes in CRM and in the triage ticket.
sam-k: Can partnerships own a Confluence template for the joint messaging doc? If so, link it in the ticket automatically when partner_id is present.
diego: I'll add a mapping in triage service: partner_template_map[partner_id] -> template_url. If none, default to /confluence/si/joint-messaging-template.
li-zhang: Reporting: create a weekly pulse post to #partnerships-pulse with counts: total marketplace leads, hw_partner leads, si-claimed, avg triage time. Format: "YYYY-MM-DD | Mkt:10 | HW:3 | SI-Claimed:2 | AvgAcknowledge:4h"
alexa: Final asks: (a) document gating rules and examples, (b) confirmation on TTL and SLA, (c) automation to create SI tickets from bot listings. Action owners: diego -> push gating doc, sam -> implement intake flag, li -> create pulse automation, alexa -> consolidate contract language for SLAs. We'll reconvene on Thursday. :rocket:
